correctness.rationale: Full family of p distinct length-n phase factors determines equivalence i~j iff letters at i,j agree in every phase, exactly i=j mod p by primitiveness of the cyclic period. Thus all symmetries induce permutations f of residue blocks and any within-block permutation works. Each color-run occupies a cyclic interval in residue space, and the cyclic-interval incidence family reconstructs cycle adjacency from maximal two-point co-occurrence for 2<=a_i<=p-2; induced f must be dihedral. Reflection would reverse the cyclic order of q>=3 distinct run labels and is impossible. If all runs length one, distinct phase labels force f to be a rotation directly. For n=mp+r, block sizes m+1 for first r and m for the rest: nonempty proper cyclic interval has no nontrivial rotational stabilizer, so r>0 only within-residue permutations; r=0 allows full cyclic block shift. Independent brute permutation checks: abc at n=3,4,6 yields group orders 3,2,24; aabc at n=4,5 yields 4,2; abcd at n=4 yields 4; abcc at n=5 yields 2. These confirm finite cases, not the universal classification.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks only establish the specific enumerated instances; unrestricted conclusion rests on mathematical proof.
